name: Ship That Slaughters
author: AAidalol
description: One of the first levels Aida ever made, being her first ship challenge. One of the most infamous AALL levels ever alongside Tidal Poop and Poopy Cologne. Originally made in 2022 and verified in 2025. Was placed on the first AALL, forgotten about, then re-placed on the current one. Aida also reverified this on her left hand, due to tendonitis in her right. Hardest part is 52-57.
